objective.name: sandbox.dsl.wrapper.dynamic.matter.inputs
objective.description: Instantiate params and @matter refs for a wrapper-backed capacity from a previous sub-capacity output.

#root.role: Build matter refs in one wrapper-backed step, then instantiate params and @matter dynamically for a second wrapper-backed step.

effects.wrapper_input_contract: The final wrapper receives params and @matter refs built dynamically from a previous sub-response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A DSL request becomes an explicit reflection of dynamically built params and matter refs observed by the wrapper runtime.
invariants: The flow first materializes matter ref strings through sandbox.build.matter_refs before invoking the final wrapper.
The final wrapper call consumes both a param derived from the previous payload and dynamically built @matter refs.
Only one terminal wrapper invocation occurs after the builder step.
success: On success, the terminal payload reflects the dynamically constructed params and @matter refs observed by the wrapper.
Successful execution proves that DSL can instantiate wrapper inputs from previous capacity outputs.
The terminal payload exposes received_params together with ctx_id and wrapper_name from sandbox.inspect.inputs.
failure: The flow fails if either the ref-building wrapper step or the final inspection wrapper step cannot complete.
A failure in the builder step prevents the dynamic @matter injection step from running successfully.
notes: This is the dynamic @matter injection oracle used by N7.
The scenario focuses on DSL dataflow between subcalls rather than on matter resolution itself.
